agenda.title: Registration & Telescope Alignment
agenda.description: Welcome briefing, participant check-in, and optical telescope calibration under the evening sky.

agenda.title: Lunar Science Keynote Address
agenda.description: Interactive lecture on lunar geology, crater formation, and upcoming human missions back to the Moon.

agenda.title: Guided Optical Telescope Observation
agenda.description: Live observation of crater rim shadows along the lunar terminator line, Mare Tranquillitatis, and Tycho crater.

agenda.title: Eyepiece Astrophotography Session
agenda.description: Capture high-resolution lunar photos directly through telescope eyepieces with expert photography assistance.

agenda.title: Astronomy Quiz & Award Distribution
agenda.description: Live trivia competition, announcement of winners, and distribution of official digital certificates.
